zh.title: Network Airline Management引進第5架波音747貨機
zh.summary: Network Airline Management於2026年8月3日宣布，一架前身曾服役於長榮航空與沙烏地阿拉伯航空的波音747-400BCF改裝貨機已於7月加入機隊，成為該公司第5架波音747貨機。該機國籍標誌與登記號碼為9H-AKA，將以比利時列日機場（LGG）為主要營運樞紐。
body: Network Airline Management（NAM）於2026年8月3日宣布，一架波音747-400BCF貨機已於2026年7月加入其貨運機隊。該架機齡31年、國籍標誌與登記號碼為9H-AKA的飛機，最早於1995年作為客機加入長榮航空，後改裝為貨機，並曾由沙烏地阿拉伯航空與冰島亞特蘭大航空營運。
在NAM體系下，該機由歐洲亞特蘭大航空負責營運，並以比利時列日機場為主要樞紐。Network Aviation Group執行長Jonathan Clark表示，引進第5架波音747貨機能滿足強勁的客戶需求，並提昇全球定期與包機服務的彈性。目前NAM共營運5架現役波音747貨機，其中最年輕的為一架機齡26年前中華航空貨機。

en.title: Network Airline Management Adds Fifth Boeing 747 Freighter to Fleet
en.summary: Network Airline Management announced on August 3, 2026, that a fifth Boeing 747-400BCF converted freighter joined its active cargo fleet in July 2026. Registered as 9H-AKA, the 31-year-old aircraft previously flew for EVA Air, Saudia Cargo, and Air Atlanta Icelandic before joining Network Airline Management. Operated by Air Atlanta Europe, the widebody freighter will operate out of its primary hub at Liege Airport (LGG) in Belgium to help meet strong customer demand for scheduled and charter cargo flights.
body: Network Airline Management (NAM) announced on August 3, 2026, that a fifth Boeing 747-400BCF freighter joined its active cargo fleet in July 2026. The 31-year-old aircraft, registered 9H-AKA, previously flew for EVA Air, Saudia Cargo, and Air Atlanta Icelandic before joining NAM's fleet.

Under NAM, the converted freighter is operated by Air Atlanta Europe and based at Liege Airport in Belgium. Network Aviation Group CEO Jonathan Clark stated that adding another converted freighter allows the company to keep pace with strong customer demand and enhances operational flexibility across global charter and scheduled networks. NAM's fleet now includes five active Boeing 747 freighters, with its youngest being a 26-year-old former China Airlines cargo aircraft.

zh.title: Joby Aviation合作Atoms打造美國垂直起降機場網路
zh.summary: Joby Aviation於2026年8月4日宣布，將與Uber聯合創辦人Travis Kalanick設立的智慧基礎設施公司Atoms合作，在美國開發垂直起降機場網路。雙方計畫在電動垂直起降飛行器取得監管許可後推進營運，並將優先於佛羅里達州、紐約州、德克薩斯州及加利福尼亞州尋找建置地點。Joby亦參與美國政府的eVTOL整合試點計畫。
body: Joby Aviation於2026年8月4日宣布，與Uber聯合創辦人Travis Kalanick於2021年創立的智慧基礎設施公司Atoms合作，規劃在美國開發垂直起降機場網路。該合作旨在於電動垂直起降飛行器（eVTOL）獲得監管許可後，確保必要的地面基礎設施就緒，以推動先進空中交通營運。
根據規劃，雙方將優先在佛羅里達州、紐約州、德克薩斯州及加利福尼亞州尋找潛在的垂直起降機場建置地點。加州企業Joby已參與美國政府推動的eVTOL整合試點計畫（eIPP）。Joby創辦人JoeBen Bevirt表示，隨著空中計程車邁向商業服務，具備合適的基礎設施與城市接受度至關重要。

en.title: Joby Aviation Partners With Atoms to Build US Vertiport Network
en.summary: Joby Aviation announced on August 4, 2026, that it is partnering with smart infrastructure firm Atoms, started by Uber co-founder Travis Kalanick, to build a network of vertiports in the United States. Through this partnership, the companies aim to prepare ground infrastructure for advanced air mobility operations once eVTOL aircraft receive regulatory clearance. Site search priority will be given to Florida, New York, Texas, and California. Joby is also participating in the US government eVTOL Integration Pilot Program.
body: Joby Aviation announced on August 4, 2026, that it is partnering with Atoms, a smart infrastructure firm started in 2021 by Uber co-founder Travis Kalanick, to develop a network of vertiports in the United States. Through this partnership, both companies aim to have the necessary ground infrastructure ready to roll out advanced air mobility operations as soon as eVTOL aircraft receive regulatory clearance.

The companies will give priority to Florida, New York, Texas, and California when searching for potential vertiport sites. Joby Aviation, based in California, is a participant in the US government's eVTOL Integration Pilot Program aimed at accelerating industry development. Joby founder JoeBen Bevirt noted that as air taxis approach commercial service, appropriate infrastructure and city adoption are increasingly critical.

zh.title: 蓋特威克機場第二跑道計畫獲上訴法院支持將繼續推進
zh.summary: 倫敦蓋特威克機場（LGW）於2026年8月4日表示，英國上訴法院已駁回環保團體針對該機場第二跑道擴建計畫許可提出的法律挑戰。該計畫擬將現有備用跑道平移12公尺以啟用第二條運作跑道，預計可增加約1300萬名旅客與10萬架次航班，並創造1萬4000個工作機會。
body: 倫敦蓋特威克機場於2026年8月4日發布聲明表示，英國上訴法院已正式駁回針對北部跑道計畫（Northern Runway Project）規劃許可的法律挑戰。此項規劃許可最初由英國政府於2025年9月批准，隨後遭到環保團體法律質疑，上訴法院的判決確認政府批准擴建計畫的決定合法合規。
在此之前，英國高等法院已於2026年6月23日做出判決，維持政府授予北部跑道計畫規劃許可的決定。然而，反對團體隨後發起上訴，最終由上訴法院予以審理並全面駁回。該法律訴訟由蓋特威克地區保護運動主席彼得·巴克萊（Peter Barclay）以及反對蓋特威克噪音排放社區組織（CAGNE）共同提出。
根據蓋特威克機場公佈的擴建方案內容，機場計畫將現有的備用跑道向外平移12公尺，使其能夠作為第二條完全運作的正式跑道使用。蓋特威克機場執行長皮耶-雨果·施密特（Pierre-Hugues Schmit）對法院判決表示歡迎，並強調長達八年的規劃與法律審查程序已劃下句點。
蓋特威克機場指出，這項估計耗資29億美元（折合約22億英鎊）的擴建工程將為英國帶來顯著的商業、旅遊與貿易效益，其中包括創造1萬4000個全新工作機會，並預計每年為英國經濟帶來13億美元（折合約10億英鎊）的增長挹注。
英國交通大臣海蒂·亞歷山大（Heidi Alexander）指出，此項判決是蓋特威克機場與當地社區的重要里程碑。該計畫預計能額外服務約1300萬名旅客，並增加10萬架次航班，為旅客提供更多選擇並強化英國的全球交通連結。反對組織CAGNE則表示判決令人失望，將持續對機場後續發展發揮監督作用。

en.title: Gatwick Airport to proceed with second runway as Court of Appeal rejects legal challenge
en.summary: London Gatwick Airport (LGW) announced on August 4, 2026, that the UK Court of Appeal has rejected legal challenges against government planning permission for its Northern Runway Project. Under the expansion plan, Gatwick's existing standby runway will be repositioned by 12 meters to serve as a second fully functioning operational runway. Airport officials and UK Transport Secretary Heidi Alexander noted that the 2.2 billion pound project is expected to create 14,000 new jobs, accommodate approximately 13 million additional passengers annually, and handle 100,000 more flights, despite objections raised by local campaign groups.
body: London-Gatwick Airport announced on August 4, 2026, that the UK Court of Appeal has rejected legal challenges against the planning permission granted for its Northern Runway Project. The legal decision upholds the planning approval originally issued by the UK Secretary of State for Transport in September 2025, allowing airport management to proceed with its multi-billion-pound expansion plans.

The Court of Appeal ruling follows a prior judgment by the High Court on June 23, 2026, which upheld the government's approval of the runway project. Following that ruling, environmental and local campaign groups launched an appeal. The legal challenge was brought by Peter Barclay, Chair of the Gatwick Area Conservation Campaign, alongside Communities Against Gatwick Noise Emissions (CAGNE).

Under the technical details of the development plan, Gatwick Airport intends to shift its existing standby runway by 12 meters. This repositioning will enable the facility to operate a second fully functioning runway alongside its primary runway, significantly increasing airfield capacity and operational flexibility.

Gatwick Airport estimates that the $2.9 billion (£2.2 billion) expansion project will generate substantial economic benefits for the United Kingdom. According to airport projections, the project will create approximately 14,000 new jobs and deliver an estimated $1.3 billion (£1 billion) annual boost to the national economy through increased business, trade, and tourism.

UK Transport Secretary Heidi Alexander described the court ruling as a major milestone for both Gatwick Airport and local communities. Alexander noted that the expansion is expected to accommodate around 13 million additional passengers and 100,000 more flights per year, strengthening international air connectivity. CAGNE expressed deep disappointment over the decision and stated it will continue monitoring secondary environmental issues such as airspace changes and noise.

zh.title: 日本航空推出東京迪士尼海洋25週年彩繪機 JAL Jubilee Express
zh.summary: 日本航空推出迪士尼海洋25週年彩繪機；波音737-800執飛
body: 日本航空推出慶祝東京迪士尼海洋開幕25週年的特別主題彩繪客機「JAL Jubilee Express」。該架特別彩繪客機自2026年6月4日起正式投入日本國內線客運服務，相關營運計畫預計將持續執行至2027年4月。
執飛「JAL Jubilee Express」的機型為波音737-800，國籍標誌暨登記號碼為JA339J。該架飛機全長為39.5公尺、高度為12.5公尺，翼展達到35.8公尺。機艙內部共設置165個座位，包含20個Class J座位與145個普通艙座位。
日本航空與東京迪士尼度假區營運商Oriental Land Co.最早於2026年4月16日對外發表這項彩繪機計畫。雙方的企業贊助合作關係可追溯至1983年東京迪士尼樂園開幕之際，本次推出的彩繪機亦為兩家公司自2001年首次合作打造特別圖裝以來，共同發表的第七個飛機專案。
客機機身外觀採用象徵慶祝活動的主題色彩「Jubilee Blue」進行塗裝，並繪有穿著特別週年服裝的米老鼠等迪士尼角色，以及東京迪士尼海洋地標水晶巨球與普羅米修斯火山。該機投入波音737-800機隊營運的各條國內航線，日本航空會在每日傍晚於官方網站公布隔日的具體航班編號與航線。
機艙內部同樣引進特別主題體驗，搭乘該客機的旅客可看到專屬設計的頭靠墊套，並使用三款隨機發放的主題紙杯。此外，每位乘客在每趟航班上均可獲得一張紀念搭機證明貼紙，該貼紙同樣提供三款樣式並隨機發放，相關紙杯與貼紙贈品均採限量供應、發完為止。

en.title: Japan Airlines Unveils Tokyo DisneySea 25th Anniversary Boeing 737 Aircraft
en.summary: Japan Airlines launches DisneySea anniversary 737-800; domestic service runs through April 2027
body: Japan Airlines has unveiled and launched domestic flight operations with a specially themed aircraft named the JAL Jubilee Express to celebrate the 25th anniversary of Tokyo DisneySea. The domestic passenger flights officially commenced service on June 4, 2026, and are scheduled to continue operating on various routes through April 2027.

The JAL Jubilee Express is operated using a Boeing 737-800 aircraft registered as JA339J. The aircraft measures 39.5 meters in length, 12.5 meters in height, and has a total wingspan of 35.8 meters. The interior passenger cabin accommodates 165 passengers, including 20 seating positions in Class J and 145 seats in economy class.

Japan Airlines and Oriental Land Co., the operator of Tokyo Disney Resort, first officially announced the special aircraft on April 16, 2026, ahead of its public debut. The sponsorship partnership between Japan Airlines and Tokyo Disney Resort dates back to 1983 when Tokyo Disneyland first opened, and this project marks their seventh joint aircraft collaboration following their initial special livery created in 2001.

The exterior of the aircraft is painted in Jubilee Blue, which serves as the signature theme color for Tokyo DisneySea's anniversary celebration. The custom design highlights Mickey Mouse and other Disney characters in special outfits, along with imagery of park landmarks including the AquaSphere and Mount Prometheus. The aircraft flies regular domestic routes serviced by Japan Airlines' Boeing 737-800 fleet, with flight numbers posted online the evening before.

In-flight passenger features include anniversary-themed headrest covers and custom paper cups distributed in three different random designs during flights. Additionally, passengers traveling aboard the JAL Jubilee Express receive a commemorative boarding certificate sticker, which is also distributed in three random designs at one sticker per passenger per flight, subject to available promotional supplies.

zh.title: 瑞士半私人航空PeakJet完成首航 執飛蘇黎世至馬略卡島航線
zh.summary: 瑞士半私人航空PeakJet於2026年8月1日完成首個商業航班，連接蘇黎世與馬略卡島帕爾馬。該航班由VistaJet德國子公司以Embraer Legacy 650執飛。PeakJet及其母公司不持有航空營運人許可證，定位為售賣商務機固定班次座位的平台，後續規劃開闢至尼斯與馬拉加航線。
body: 瑞士半私人航空公司PeakJet宣佈，已於2026年8月1日完成其首個商業航班。該航班運行於瑞士蘇黎世（ZRH）與西班牙馬略卡島帕爾馬（PMI）之間，標誌著這家總部位於瑞士的航空初創企業正式投入營運。
此次首航班機採用巴西航空工業（Embraer）的 Legacy 650 行政噴射機執飛，該機型最大載客量為12名乘客。此航班的實際營運作業由商務航空業者 VistaJet 位於德國的子公司負責執行。
在商業模式方面，PeakJet 與美國的 JSX 以及 Aero 等業者類似，提供固定班次且價格低於傳統商務航空的行政飛行體驗。然而，PeakJet 本身及其母公司 Peak Plus AG 均未持有航空營運人許可證（AOC）。PeakJet 將自身定位為一個營運平台，透過整合並銷售商務機在固定航線上運行的座位產能來運作。
航線規劃方面，在首開馬略卡島航線後，PeakJet 預計將進一步開設由蘇黎世直飛尼斯（NCE）以及馬拉加（AGP）的新航線，旨在瞄準高端休閒旅遊市場。

PeakJet 由 Gianni Tronza 與 Peter Baumgartner 共同創立。Gianni Tronza 曾於 Crossair、英國航空（British Airways）、美國航空（American Airlines）及阿提哈德航空（Etihad Airways）等航空公司擔任高層主管；Peter Baumgartner 則曾擔任阿提哈德航空（Etihad Airways）執行長（CEO）。
在宣布完成首航的新聞稿中，前阿提哈德航空執行長 Peter Baumgartner 表示，多年來私人航空領域僅提供購買整架飛機或包下整架飛機兩種選擇，而 PeakJet 如今證實了建立在產業尚未充分利用的科技基礎上的第三種可行模式。

en.title: Swiss Semi-Private Startup PeakJet Completes First Flight to Mallorca
en.summary: Swiss semi-private aviation startup PeakJet has completed its first commercial flight between Zürich and Palma de Mallorca on August 1, 2026. The flight was operated by VistaJet’s German subsidiary using an Embraer Legacy 650 aircraft capable of carrying up to 12 passengers. PeakJet and its parent entity Peak Plus AG do not hold an air operator certificate, functioning as a marketplace for scheduled executive jet seats. The carrier plans future route expansion to Nice and Málaga.
body: Swiss semi-private aviation startup PeakJet has announced the completion of its first commercial flight between Zürich (ZRH)                                                                                                                                                                                             and Palma de Mallorca (PMI)                                                                                                                                                                                             on August 1, 2026. The milestone flight marks the official operational debut for the Swiss-based aviation startup.

The inaugural flight was operated using an Embraer Legacy 650 executive jet capable of carrying up to 12 passengers. Operational management of the flight was handled by the German subsidiary of business aviation operator VistaJet.

PeakJet operates on a business model similar to US operators such as JSX and Aero, offering scheduled executive aviation experiences at significantly lower price points than standard business jet charters. However, neither PeakJet nor its parent company, Peak Plus AG, holds an air operator certificate (AOC). Instead, the company defines itself as a marketplace that aggregates and sells capacity on executive aircraft operating fixed schedules.

Following the launch of the Mallorca route, PeakJet expects to open new direct flights connecting Zurich with Nice-Côte d’Azur (NCE)                                                                                                                                                                                             and Málaga (AGP)                                                                                                                                                                                             to serve the high-end leisure travel market.

The startup was co-founded by Gianni Tronza, who previously held senior executive positions at carriers including Crossair, British Airways, American Airlines, and Etihad, along with Peter Baumgartner, the former Chief Executive Officer of Etihad Airways.

In a press release announcing the completion of PeakJet's first flight, former Etihad Airways Chief Executive Officer Peter Baumgartner stated that private aviation previously offered travelers only two options: buying or chartering an entire jet, or remaining on the ground. Baumgartner noted that the company has now proven a third alternative utilizing technology that the aviation industry has barely tapped into.

zh.title: 樟宜機場攜手SATS推出自主導航輪椅服務
zh.summary: 根據 AeroTime 報導，樟宜機場集團與地勤夥伴 SATS 於 2026 年 8 月 4 日宣布推出自主導航輪椅，旨在提高行動不便旅客的便利性。該輪椅配備智慧導航與安全功能，預計全面推廣後可分擔約 10% 的日常行動協助需求，此前測試已有逾 1.3 萬名旅客使用。
body: 樟宜機場集團（CAG）與地勤合作夥伴 SATS 於 2026 年 8 月 4 日宣布，在新加坡樟宜機場正式推出自主導航輪椅，以協助行動不便的旅客在航廈內更獨立地移動，並釋放地勤人力以專注於高需求的旅客。
該自主輪椅計畫屬於 SATS「未來樞紐地勤」倡議的一環。此款輪椅配備感測器與安全帶監測等安全機制，預計全面部署後可處理該機場約 10% 的日常行動協助需求。該技術自 2025 年 3 月起在第 3 航廈展開測試，至今已服務逾 1.3 萬名旅客。

en.title: Changi Airport Rolls Out Autonomous Wheelchairs for Mobility-Impaired Travelers
en.summary: According to AeroTime, Changi Airport Group (CAG) and its ground handling partner SATS announced the rollout of autonomous wheelchairs at Singapore Changi Airport on August 4, 2026. The self-driving wheelchairs are designed to help passengers with reduced mobility navigate terminals independently, reducing the need for one-on-one staff assistance. The initiative, part of SATS' 'Hub Handler of the Future' project, is expected to eventually handle approximately 10% of Changi's daily mobility assistance demands. The technology underwent trials beginning in March 2025, serving over 13,000 passengers during the testing phase.
body: Changi Airport Group (CAG) and ground handling partner SATS announced on August 4, 2026, the rollout of autonomous wheelchairs at Changi Airport. The self-driving wheelchairs allow passengers with reduced mobility to navigate transit areas with greater independence, reducing the need for one-on-one assistance from ground staff.

The program is part of SATS' "Hub Handler of the Future" initiative and is expected to manage approximately 10% of daily mobility assistance needs at Changi once fully deployed. Equipped with sensors and seatbelt monitoring, the technology was first trialed in March 2025 and has already served more than 13,000 passengers.
